title: The rectangular chart yields a complete collar-core certification scaffold and a controlled interior locator

partition: epsilon<=c<=2-q-epsilon and epsilon<=z<=1-epsilon: compact interior core
cover_contract.corner_rule: Overlapping collars, especially z<=epsilon with c>=2-q-epsilon, must be certified jointly; one-face limits cannot be multiplied into a corner theorem.
cover_contract.core_method: Use K1749's positive-denominator Arb integrand. A candidate upper bound needs whole-line compact-plus-tail enclosure; pruning lower bounds may integrate a compact y interval only because the omitted Fisher density is nonnegative.
cover_contract.acceptance: Every core box is either pruned against the candidate upper bound or belongs to one interval-Newton uniqueness enclosure, and every collar including overlaps has an explicit bound. Unresolved boxes make the global verdict false.

scope_guard: The locator and boundary comparisons are computed evidence. Only K1753's two-point order is interval-certified; no global result follows until the cover acceptance rule passes.
